newsitem.title: JAPAN: Canon says to enter LCD colour filter market.
newsitem.headline: Canon says to enter LCD colour filter market.

text.p: Canon Inc said on Tuesday it will enter the liquid-crystal-display (LCD) colour filter market by launching low-cost, high-quality filters later this year.
Canon said in a statement that one of its units will begin mass production of the filters at the end of this year with an initial production target of 50,000 units per month.
The filters will be initially supplied to Toshiba Corp, Canon said.
Within three years, production is expected to reach 200,000 units per month, Canon said, adding that it has set an annual sales target of over 10 billion yen.
A colour filter is a component that converts an LCD into a colour display, and normally accounts for at least 10 percent of the cost of an LCD, Canon said.
Canon said costs have also been cut because the production time for the new filters is only one-third of that required to currently make a filter.
